annotations.title: 広告媒体の一覧を見る

description: Use this when the user asks which advertising media Ad Arch can arrange, or wants the facts about one medium. Returns the media and, for each, what Ad Arch handles, the lead time to start (where it is fixed), the buying unit, the video format, and how to request a quote. If a prefecture is given (city optional; defaults to the most populous city), also returns the lowest monthly rate for TVer ads in that area (JPY, excluding tax, guide only). `media` narrows the list to media whose name contains that text; if nothing matches, the full list is returned. `purpose` is required. Returns no Ad Arch prices other than TVer.

city.description: City, ward, town or village, in Japanese (e.g. 高松市).

media.description: Part of a medium's name, to narrow the list (e.g. シネアド / サイネージ / 折込).

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture of the target area, in Japanese (e.g. 香川県).

purpose.description: What the advertising is for (e.g. 採用 / 見学会の集客 / 新商品の告知). Required.

role.description: The user's position: company = a business commissioning production or advertising / creator = a videographer, editor or other creator / agency = an advertising agency or production company.

target.description: Intended audience (e.g. 20代の求職者 / 近所の家族連れ).

name: list_ad_media

available.description: Advertising media Ad Arch can arrange.

quote.description: The request type and medium name to use when requesting a quote for this medium.

reach.description: TVer only, when a prefecture was given: the lowest monthly rate for the area.

error.description: Reason the request could not be answered, in Japanese.

message.description: Message for the user, in Japanese.

needRole.description: true when the call was made without `role`; nothing else is returned.

notAvailable.description: true when the tool is not available for the given role.

note.description: Notes that apply to the result, in Japanese.

title: 広告媒体の一覧を見る
